summary: Independent RED-TEAM on E1688 (stand test2, build 872acd2). Go suite green; healthz 200 build_ref 872acd2. Owner scoping cannot widen under search; cross-user search [] and cross-delete 404 with foreign note intact. Auth precedes method/body (401+WWW-Authenticate, no side effects). Query semantics (trim/empty no-op/case-insensitive/[]/UserID hidden) and 512-byte cap verified live. Errors static, no leaks. UI state machine sound, no XSS sinks. Canary 3/3; fault-catalog 20/0; fault-catalog-exec 20/20; catalog-invariants OK. Only low/info residuals.

findings.title: Search never widens owner scope; A cannot read/delete B's note
findings.evidence: ListNotes(UserID) then q-filter; live cross-user search [] and cross-delete 404.

findings.title: Unauth /api/notes* 401+WWW-Authenticate before method/body
findings.evidence: requireAuth precedes method switch; live unauth GET/POST/DELETE -> 401, no side effects.

findings.title: Query semantics conform
findings.evidence: trim/ToLower, empty no-op byte-identical, case-insensitive, [] not null, UserID json:-; live + unit.

findings.title: Error envelopes static, no leaks
findings.evidence: fixed strings; live 400/404/405 Allow; TestDeleteErrorEnvelope leak scan.

findings.title: Oversized query capped
findings.evidence: 512-byte q -> 200, 513 -> 400 query too long before scan.

findings.title: No data race on search path
findings.evidence: single-mutex store, filter over value copies; -race unavailable (no cgo).

findings.title: DELETE id accepts Atoi alternate forms (0027,+27) as same note
findings.evidence: strconv.Atoi; owner-scoped re-check, no escalation; wire-contract quirk.

findings.title: Unbounded per-user note count (self-DoS, pre-existing)
findings.evidence: AddNote no per-user cap; self-inflicted only.

findings.title: Case-insensitivity uses per-rune ToLower (no full Unicode folding)
findings.evidence: consistent; live dotted-I probe no asymmetry.

findings.title: UI search filters cached notes loaded at page load
findings.evidence: filterNotes over notes[]; delete-404 reloads; stale-query handled (SEARCH-E2E-8).
